methods_en: Four small program families and three refactored versions were passed through program/explanation round trips. Exhaustive or dense input-domain execution checks assessed program equivalence, and multilingual explanations were analyzed for relational geometry.
results_en: All 229014 execution comparisons agreed. Explanation-text local/recurrence/bridge AUCs were 0.697/0.712/0.803. Corresponding bridge AUCs at block sizes 1/2/4/8/12 were 0.806/0.737/0.655/0.581/0.540.
interpretation_en: Across four program families, 229014 execution comparisons preserve program semantics over the tested input domains. Their explanations also carry measurable relational structure.
